task: 对比 2017 年与 2018 年圣保罗州（SP）已完成订单的销售额。
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND c.customer_state='SP' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2017%'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND c.customer_state='SP' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'
expect: 两年 SP 销售额 + 对比结论
notes: 两步各查一年；结论含两值

task: 对比 2017 年与 2018 年已完成订单的订单量。

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'
expect: 两年订单量 + 对比结论

gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND c.customer_state='SP' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND c.customer_state='RJ' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'
expect: 两州销售额 + 对比结论

task: 对比 2018 年信用卡（credit_card）与 boleto 两种支付方式的支付总额。
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' AND p.payment_type='credit_card'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' AND p.payment_type='boleto'
expect: 两种支付方式金额 + 对比结论

task: 对比 2017 年与 2018 年的客单价（销售额 ÷ 订单量）。
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2017%'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'
expect: 两年客单价 + 对比结论

task: 对比 2017 年与 2018 年订单评价的差评率（评分 ≤2 分的占比，百分比；按全部评价统计、按订单下单时间归年，不做订单状态过滤）。
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score<=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2017%'
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score<=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'
expect: 两年差评率 + 对比结论
notes: 评价口径：评分≤2 占比；按订单下单年分组

task: 找出 2018 年商品金额（order_items.price 合计）最高的三个品类，并汇总它们的商品金额。
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(x.s),2) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS s FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products pr ON oi.product_id=pr.product_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' GROUP BY pr.product_category_name ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 3) x
expect: Top3 品类 + 合计金额
notes: query 出 Top3 行 → compute 求和

task: 2018 年支付总额中，信用卡支付的占比（百分比）是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_type='credit_card' THEN p.payment_value ELSE 0 END)/SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'
expect: 信用卡占比（%）

task: 从 2017 年到 2018 年，已完成订单销售额的增长率（百分比）是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2017%'
SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'

SELECT ROUND(100.0*(b-a)/a,2) FROM (SELECT (SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2017%') a, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%') b)
expect: 两年总额 + 增长率

task: 2018 年各月销售额中，最高的三个月合计是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(x.g),2) FROM (SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) AS g FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY g DESC LIMIT 3) x
expect: 最高三月合计金额
notes: query 月度序列 → compute 取 Top3 求和

task: 2018 年上半年（1–6 月）与下半年（7–12 月）的销售额差额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER)<=6 THEN p.payment_value ELSE 0 END),2) AS h1, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER)>6 THEN p.payment_value ELSE 0 END),2) AS h2 FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'

SELECT ROUND(ABS((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER)<=6 THEN p.payment_value ELSE 0 END) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%') - (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER)>6 THEN p.payment_value ELSE 0 END) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%')),2)
expect: 上半年、下半年金额 + 差额

task: 2018 年订单的平均商品件数（总件数 ÷ 订单数）是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),3) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'
expect: 总件数、订单数 + 平均件数

task: 2018 年圣保罗州（SP）的销售额占全国销售额的比例（百分比）是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND c.customer_state='SP' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'
SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'

SELECT ROUND(100.0*(SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND c.customer_state='SP' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%')/(SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'),2)
expect: SP 额、全国额 + 占比

task: 2018 年商品金额（order_items.price 合计）最高的五个品类中，第一名是第五名的多少倍？
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(s), MIN(s) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS s FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products pr ON oi.product_id=pr.product_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' GROUP BY pr.product_category_name ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 5) x

SELECT ROUND(MAX(s)*1.0/MIN(s),2) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS s FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products pr ON oi.product_id=pr.product_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' GROUP BY pr.product_category_name ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 5) x
expect: 第一名和第五名金额 + 倍数

gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'
expect: 客单价定义 + 数值

task: 销售额的默认口径是什么？按默认口径计算 2018 年 6 月已完成订单的销售额。
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018-06%'
expect: 默认口径说明 + 2018-06 销售额

task: 「订单平均商品金额」的定义是什么？按该定义计算 2018 年已完成订单的订单平均商品金额。
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'
expect: 定义 + 数值

task: 配送时长的默认计算口径是什么？用该口径计算 2018 年已完成订单的平均配送天数。
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(o.order_delivered_customer_date)-JULIANDAY(o.order_purchase_timestamp)),2) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
expect: 口径说明 + 平均配送天数

task: 「客户数」的统计口径是什么（按哪个字段去重）？按该口径统计 2018 年已完成订单的客户数。
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'
expect: 去重字段说明 + 客户数

task: 商品金额与运费的字段在哪里？2018 年已完成订单的「商品金额＋运费」合计是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price)+SUM(oi.freight_value),2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%'
expect: 字段位置说明 + 合计

task: 先查询 2018 年各月的销售额，再定位销售额最低的月份及其销售额。
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(g,2) FROM (SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) AS g FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY g ASC LIMIT 1) x
expect: 月度序列 + 最低月与数值
notes: 全 delivered 口径；2018 年含 1–8 月

task: 先查询各州的全期销售额，再下钻查看销售额最高州的已完成订单量。
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND c.customer_state = (SELECT c2.customer_state FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o2 ON p.order_id=o2.order_id JOIN customers c2 ON c2.customer_id=o2.customer_id WHERE o2.order_status='delivered' GROUP BY c2.customer_state ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_value) DESC LIMIT 1)
expect: 最高州 + 该州订单量

task: 先看 2018 年各品类商品金额（order_items.price 合计）的前五名，再找出商品金额最低的品类及其金额。
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(MIN(s),2) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS s FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products pr ON oi.product_id=pr.product_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' GROUP BY pr.product_category_name) x
expect: Top5 + 最低品类与金额

task: 先查询 2018 年各月订单评价的平均评分（按全部评价统计、按订单下单时间归月，不做订单状态过滤），再找出平均评分最低的月份及其评分。
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(MIN(a),3) FROM (SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS a FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp)) x
expect: 月度平均评分 + 最低月份与评分
notes: 评价按订单下单月分组

task: 先查询 2018 年各月的订单量，算出有数据月份的月均订单量，再找出低于月均的月份数量。
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt),2) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp)) x

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp)) x WHERE x.cnt < (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp)))
expect: 月均订单量 + 低于月均月份数
